description: Groq is an AI inference company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Mountain View, USA, running models on its own LPU chips through GroqCloud. In December 2025 it signed a non-exclusive technology licensing agreement with Nvidia and continues to operate GroqCloud independently. Its speech offering is hosted Whisper speech-to-text and Canopy Labs Orpheus text-to-speech.
name: Groq
